routes.detail: Index Dashboard under Layout at line 573; lazy import at line 31. Route declaration inspected, not mounted in a browser.

purpose: Configurable fleet-operations workspace combining vehicle readiness, current evidence, recent activity and workflow navigation, with saved dashboards, widget discovery and presentation/export tools.
primaryGoal: Understand the fleet and selected vehicle from trustworthy source readings, investigate exceptions, and customize the workspace without losing saved layouts or independent widget capabilities.

auditScope.mode: Read-only source audit of ONE mounted page and bounded dependencies; only report and heartbeat writes.
auditScope.migrationPolicy: Preserve the existing source migration, DashboardSourceBrief/OperationalBrief adoption, trust-aware fleet batch, SI display adapters and custom grid implementation. No restart, old-source transplant or widget deletion.
auditScope.dependencyBound: Full page; nine seeded widget entry implementations; selected grid, layout, picker, presentation, brief and dialog excerpts; targeted hook/router/shell/CSS evidence. Registry index imports sixteen categories; vehicle registry metadata was fully read and six other category files were searched only for seeded ID-to-component mappings. Neither all registry widget bodies nor a claimed 194-file graph were audited.

dataSources.name: Vehicle inventory
dataSources.behavior: Shared vehicles cache, FAST stale time, AbortSignal forwarding and safeArray select. Root inventory controls skeleton, layout controls, onboarding and grid entry. Widgets observe the same cache.

dataSources.name: Tesla authorization and explicit inventory sync
dataSources.behavior: Sync is user-triggered, live-mode guarded, networkMode always, invalidates/broadcasts inventory and uses existing mutation toasts. Page imports sync from useVehicles, not the separate useSettings export.

dataSources.name: Saved dashboard hydration and persistence
dataSources.behavior: Local-first snapshots, two-second debounced server saves, pending-save dirty state, newer-server hydration, registry reconciliation, cross-tab broadcast and undo history. Keep storage identities and unsynced local edits.

dataSources.name: Selected and widget-specific vehicle state
dataSources.behavior: Widget config vehicle overrides dashboard settings vehicle, then workspace vehicle; individual widget fallback is typically first inventory vehicle. Hero uses actual observedAt/verified fields, bounded recovery polling while evidence is not fresh and live firmware fallback. BatteryGauge and ChargeStatus share state cache. as_of disables automatic polling. useVehicleLive implementation was not followed beyond its hero caller.

dataSources.name: Fleet posture
dataSources.behavior: One request per bounded batch, server summary plus retained per-vehicle evidence, live recovery and partial/unavailable distinctions. FleetOperationsBrief retains total/verified/attention/oldest-reading metrics, active vehicle evidence and details navigation. No fabricated zero summary while pending.

dataSources.name: Current climate and security
dataSources.behavior: Five-second widget refresh request, enabled only for positive IDs, cancellable reads. Preserve cabin/outside temperatures, HVAC resolution, defrost/heater details and lock/sentry/door/window distinctions. Handler timestamp/freshness semantics not audited.

dataSources.name: Recent five drives
dataSources.behavior: Key ['drives', id, 'recent-5']; distance_m, duration_s, start/end SOC and timestamp feed links to /drives/{id} plus View all. Historical provenance and unknown values remain; this is a recent-five widget, not a whole-page range aggregate.

dataSources.name: Onboarding source evidence
dataSources.behavior: Combined source trust, unknown-source badges, localized CTAs, command-palette bridge, progress, dismissal and restart. Checklist policy and push/auth internals remain outside this bounded inspection.

dataSources.name: Realtime invalidation and local preferences
dataSources.behavior: Singleton SSE subscription; vehicle events invalidate inventory and fallback invalidates queries. Theme/hint dismissal, kiosk config and layout preferences are browser-local. QuickNav has no independent backend source. No new request client or server state store.

dataSources.name: Optional generated starter and nonseed widgets
dataSources.behavior: TemplateGallery exposes __helix__ widget_ids preview and applies explicitly selected draft at lines 94-103. Draft query owner and the nonseed widget APIs were not inspected; preserve them without inventing endpoint capabilities.

components.detail: Already consumes semantic context/secondary/primary/overflow slots and min-w-0 container behavior. PageLayout is the existing PageContainer adapter, not a migration stub.
Most imports already use category barrels; useTheme remains a concrete ThemeProvider import at line 34. No direct recharts/react-leaflet/framer-motion import in page.
Preserve feature ownership and existing react-grid-layout engine. Grid independently owns desktop gestures, mobile order, discrete arrange actions, lazy loading, error isolation and fullscreen.

Current migration is real: climate/charge/fleet metrics use typed source bridges and existing operational formatter. Gauge/status/feed bodies remain specialist components; do not flatten to a generic KPI list.
Four local nonexported helpers plus one exported page. Local helper count is not five competing exported page components.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Hero adapter overrides nested .relative/.p-4/.mt-6/.text-2xl class shapes to suppress padding, gradient and density. This is coupling to child internals rather than a typed embedded variant.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep both existing renderers; add an explicit embedded/compact presentation contract to VehicleHero in an assigned dashboard follow-up and remove only the equivalent structural overrides.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Compact climate/charge widgets stack WidgetShell title/freshness with OperationalBrief eyebrow/title/description/scope/provenance/freshness. Both layers preserve important evidence but may make metadata heavier than the readings in one-column cards. Geometry was not rendered.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse existing compact OperationalBrief and WidgetShell options; establish one primary title/reading hierarchy and keep complete source explanations reachable. Do not delete trust metadata or replace prior migration.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Page header/command reset and LayoutSwitcher reset intentionally use the same danger-confirm text and useConfirm contract. This is existing behavior, not a reason to remove either reset entry.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain confirmations and both entry points; any later DRY extraction should remain dashboard-local and preserve the distinct reset callback wiring.

Header actions wrap; icon-only add/arrange labels remain via aria-label when visible text hides below sm.
Measured container selects active breakpoint; xs flex stack shares same widget body rather than dropping widgets.

Dock has bounded 60dvh mobile height and own list scroll; xl sticky 340px sidebar.
Onboarding split only at xl; features stack 1/2/4 columns; loading skeleton has corresponding responsive geometry.

issues.detail: Layout menu has absolute left-0 positioning and min-width 16rem with no local max-width/clamp in this class. Long labels, narrow allocated width and zoom require actual review; no overflow failure is claimed.
issues.fix: Test open menu at 320/375px, zoom and long localized names; retain all actions and use existing Popover anchoring/clamping if a real failure is reproduced.

responsive.unverified: All real viewport/allocated-width screenshots, touch, RTL, 200% text, nested scroll, fullscreen and kiosk behavior.

existingSupport.detail: More trigger has localized accessible name, dialog popup semantics and expanded state; uses shared Popover.
Named dashboard layouts/widgets regions, localizable actions and loading status/VisuallyHidden at lines 1039-1046.
Fullscreen uses existing fullscreen Modal and autofocus close control.
44px edit actions and shared Popover; discrete arrangement provides an alternative to dragging, with announcements and initial panel focus.
Enter adds matching widget; Ctrl/Meta+Enter adds/closes; announcements and next-addable focus at lines 216-281. Category pills are filters, not false tabs.
Fleet posture changes have VisuallyHidden live announcement; text accompanies status color.
Progressbar min/max/value and localized label; task unknown badges, CTA names and restart remain.

issues.detail: Fullscreen button is opacity-0 until group hover or focus-visible, including the mobile stack. Keyboard visibility exists; persistent touch discoverability does not appear in this class.
issues.fix: Keep the action and localized name; make chrome visible for coarse-pointer/non-hover or small-container presentation without competing with widget freshness controls.

issues.detail: Dock close uses explicit h-9 w-9 (36px), unlike adjacent widget edit/fullscreen actions that explicitly use 44px. Effective computed sizing and spacing exception are unverified.
issues.fix: Use the existing Button 44px sizing for mobile or document a measured WCAG spacing exception; preserve search/Escape behavior.

issues.detail: Duplicate/save-as and rename use native window.prompt (rename at line 176), outside the themed shared form/dialog composition. Menu key handler at lines 114-127 only handles Escape; role=menu is set at line 259 without menu roving keys in the inspected local handler.
issues.fix: Retain duplicate and rename functionality/names; use existing Modal/Input for the prompt and shared keyboard popup behavior or ordinary dialog/list semantics. Do not create another focus engine.

issues.detail: Global shortcut listener skips inputs/selects/contenteditable, but no explicit dialog-open guard is visible. E or Escape while focused on a popup button may also toggle/exit dashboard edit mode. Actual event arbitration by shared overlays was not exercised.
issues.fix: Verify Modal/Popover shortcut arbitration first; if reproduced, integrate with the existing overlay/shortcut owner, preserving E/Escape/undo/redo/Alt+1-9 and cheatsheet registration.

unverified: Touch targets after shared CSS composition

loading.detail: Inventory-only skeleton swaps primary body; header remains live. Widget lazy Suspense and WidgetShell initial source skeletons remain independent.

empty.detail: Zero vehicles shows contextual EmptyOnboarding with account-connect or inventory-sync CTA, exploration, privacy and setup progress. Empty saved layout has separate Add widgets/Browse starter layouts CTAs in DashboardGrid:715-725.

error.detail: Fatal inventory failure is passed to PageLayout unless auth is pending or explicitly disconnected; PageContainer:247-268 then replaces children with ErrorDisplay. Retained inventory error is nonfatal. WidgetShell:191-205 distinguishes initial/fatal error from retained children and retries; standard grid body has SectionErrorBoundary.

staleOfflinePartial.detail: Registry StaleRefreshWarning, live stale banner and shared source-state widgets coexist. SSE fallback invalidates queries. Fleet trust combines discovery/partial evidence and retained results; hero uses real observation freshness. Shared offline/banner implementations were not semantically inspected.

successDisabled.detail: Undo/redo disabled by history; refresh/sync loading indicators; layout dirty signal goes to switcher; picker already-added controls disabled; import validation, export overlength warning and existing mutation toasts retained.

issues.detail: handleRefresh clears isRefreshing only after Promise.all succeeds, not in finally. An exceptional invalidation promise can leave the refresh action busy. No runtime rejection was reproduced.
issues.fix: Preserve every invalidation key and wrap busy reset in finally; route exceptional feedback through existing error/toast mechanisms.

issues.detail: Fullscreen widget render has Suspense but not the SectionErrorBoundary used by normal widget body at line 671. A widget throw inside fullscreen lacks the same local recovery surface.
issues.fix: Reuse SectionErrorBoundary inside existing fullscreen Modal, preserving header/close, widget props and retry; do not replace the fullscreen capability.

issues.detail: If auth status fails with no data while inventory is empty, EmptyOnboarding receives authenticated=false through auth?.authenticated ?? false at line 755. No local auth-error/pending recovery is passed, so unknown authorization can look like a definite setup-required state.
issues.fix: Preserve onboarding and account-connect/sync actions, but distinguish pending/failed authorization using the existing data-state contract rather than a boolean fallback alone.

states.runtimeAcceptance: UNVERIFIED: no loading/empty/failure/retained/offline/partial fixture or live browser execution.

visualIssues.detail: Climate heading icon retains text-neon-cyan despite surrounding migrated source summary. This is a concrete residual accent, not evidence that the whole Dashboard is neon.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing restrained icon/semantic text token; retain the thermometer cue, values and all HVAC/defrost/heater states.

visualIssues.detail: Each changed request timestamp can activate a hardcoded green 12px glow for 1.5 seconds (effect lines 80-97). On independently refreshed widgets this adds decorative competing freshness emphasis; it is not source-observation evidence. OS motion-reduce shadow suppression exists.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse the visible DataFreshness/trust feedback and restrained transient surface/border if needed; remove hardcoded glow without removing refresh/error/retained-data controls.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-042; mission section 31: avoid ambient loops
visualIssues.detail: Desktop edit-mode panels wobble indefinitely at two-second intervals. Drag/resize pauses and OS reduced-motion override exist, but all idle editable panels remain animated in normal mode.
visualIssues.fix: Shared stylesheet owner should replace continuous wobble with static edit chrome; preserve drag geometry, resize handles, explicit reduced-motion behavior and short user-action drop feedback.

visualIssues.detail: Picker cards/icons/dividers/search-result block use fixed translucent white fills/borders at lines 338-345,453,462. Parent dock already uses neutral surface/border variables; these interior exceptions can lose distinction in light mode.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse surface/control/border tokens for card/rest/hover/disabled states and typography roles. Preserve search highlighting, icons, descriptions, grid footprint, categories and added-state badge.

visualIssues.detail: Export explicitly overrides Modal with bg-[#0f1218], white border and text-on-accent while descendants use text-primary/muted. This hardcodes a dark surface into a theme-aware overlay.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing Modal surface/border/text defaults; preserve preview, name/date/count/bytes, JSON download, clipboard and URL limit feedback.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-042: motion is feedback, not ambient decoration
visualIssues.detail: Charging icon pulses continuously while status is charging. The background gradient at line 92 is neutral and is already suppressed by the embedded adapter, so it is not counted as an active page neon violation.
visualIssues.fix: Use static semantic charging cue; retain text, power/rate/ETA details and charging-specific gauges. Preserve global OS reduced-motion policy.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-002/MDC-046 and mission section 33: cancellable typed hook ownership
architectureIssues.detail: RecentDrives owns a local useQuery/request in presentation and ignores the query AbortSignal. Other inspected reads forward signal. It is enabled per vehicle but obsolete scope/unmount work is not cancelled by this caller.
architectureIssues.fix: Move this exact recent-five read to the existing driving API-hook owner in an assigned integration item; preserve key, limit, historical provenance, raw SI values and behavior while forwarding signal.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-046: one source of default composition
architectureIssues.detail: Default widget-ID set is manually mirrored for the delayed customization hint; actual seed lives in useDashboardLayout:291-310. Current nine IDs match. The comment points to an older line 182; future composition drift can change hint behavior.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve the current matched seed and hint timing; reuse a stable default-ID helper from the existing layout owner if later refactoring this concern, without exporting a cyclic state graph.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-026/MDC-033: source age versus fetch time
architectureIssues.detail: Climate passes query dataUpdatedAt to freshness; SecurityStatusWidget:139 and ChargeStatusWidget:79 also do. Hero deliberately uses observedAt instead. Whether latest endpoints provide a trustworthy observation timestamp was not followed into handlers, so source-age correctness remains an integration question, not a proven backend defect.
architectureIssues.fix: Verify returned timestamp contracts before changing display; reuse observation-aware freshness when established and distinguish fetched/cached time from telemetry age. Never synthesize observation freshness.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-030/MDC-046: real route and import preservation
architectureIssues.detail: Share URL uses /dashboard#import= while audited mounted route is /. Targeted App route search found no Dashboard alias declaration, but redirect normalization elsewhere was not traced. Page command comment also refers to /dashboard at lines 481-483.
architectureIssues.fix: Verify alias/deep-link handling before changing; ensure exported URL reaches the canonical Dashboard with hash preserved and validated preview. Keep existing links compatible; no unsupported missing-route claim.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-046: preserve settings without pretending consumption
architectureIssues.detail: Modal persists refreshRate/timeRange/showTitle config. Inspected seed widgets often destructure only vehicleId/size and hardcode/default polling; no common consumption of these options was established in the sampled bodies. This is a bounded settings-effect gap, not permission to remove controls.
architectureIssues.fix: Trace each configurable widget in a separate bounded integration task and wire unsupported settings through existing owners only after confirming intended semantics. Keep saved config and widget-level independent scope intact.

priority.level: P1 targeted preservation and trust follow-up; P2 residual presentation cleanup
priority.rationale: The page is already a substantial migrated operations workspace, not a skeleton. Highest follow-up value is fullscreen failure isolation, unknown auth handling, cancellable recent-drive query, and real keyboard/touch checks. Visual work is limited to residual glows/loops/hardcoded surfaces, not a restart.
